en.bodyHtml:
Add Microsoft 365 mail in Outlook on your telefoon is solved by comparing webmail to the client: if webmail works, fix IMAP/SMTP settings.

Client faults look like server outages until webmail proves otherwise.

What this article covers

You carry out “Add Microsoft 365 mail in Outlook on your telefoon” via mailbox, client and DNS auth, with backup awareness and verification.

Unique checkpoints

This long-form guide is written for Add Microsoft 365 mail in Outlook on your telefoon (slug microsoft-365-mail-toevoegen-in-outlook-op-je-telefoon).

  • Correct hostnames/ports
  • Webmail URL

How to execute

  1. Sign in to webmail with the same mailbox as in “Add Microsoft 365 mail in Outlook on your telefoon”.
  2. If webmail works: reconfigure the client (IMAP in, SMTP out, SSL/TLS).
  3. Use the full email address as username.
  4. Check whether a VPN/firewall blocks ports 993/465/587.
  5. Send a test to an external address and confirm delivery.
  6. Repeat the core check for “Add Microsoft 365 mail in Outlook on your telefoon” from a second network or private window.

  • Old POP profiles that delete mail from the server.

If it goes wrong

  1. Restore the previous value you noted for “Add Microsoft 365 mail in Outlook on your telefoon”.
  2. Restore from backup only if the live state is corrupt — selectively where possible.
